description: A member's read state in one channel (C8; prd-sew-14 §5).

last_message_id.description:
The channel's newest timeline message (omitted in READY, where the channel entry has
it).

last_read_id.description:
The read cursor: a comparator, possibly a synthetic id (mark unread writes
`message_id − 1`). Absent = nothing read.

mention_count.description: Unread mentions (a muted channel counts direct mentions only).

muted.description: The member muted the channel (S21); present only when true.

seq.description: The member change-log head this state is current as of (S14 gap G9).

unread.description: Whether a message by someone else is past the cursor.

title: ReadState
